run_nerf_training: run the NeRF training loop on LLFF, Blender, or DeepVoxels dataset types with configurable network depth and learning rate
render_rays_volumetric: render a batch of camera rays through the NeRF model to produce RGB, disparity, and accumulated opacity maps
create_nerf_model: create a NeRF MLP model with coarse and optional fine networks, positional embeddings, and view direction support
render_path_images: render images along a sequence of camera poses and optionally save them to disk with PSNR metrics
batchify_rays_chunked: render rays in smaller minibatches to avoid out-of-memory errors during NeRF inference
